label: MksBEFG system
definition: A Wadjet system in which an organism possesses an MksBEFG derivative SMC locus encoding MksB, MksE, MksF, and MksG components that mediate MksG-dependent plasmid DNA degradation.
observations: MksBEFG branch under Wadjet system; distinct from individual MksB, MksE, MksF, or MksG proteins, mks genes, isolated MksBEFG protein-complex activity, MksG nuclease activity outside a complete organism-level system, broad Wadjet systems, JetABCD, EptABCD, DefenseFinder Wadjet I-III detector boundaries, plasmid transformation, and other anti-plasmid systems.
